description:
Add the Aiven for ClickHouse native platform adapter, modeled on ch-altinity-adapter (AivenAdapter(ClickHouseAdapter), key `aiven-clickhouse`, experimental). Aiven publishes literal connection recipes for both native (clickhouse-driver, secure=True) and HTTPS transports.

DECISION GATE: proceeds only after ch-tier2-spike records a go for Aiven AND wave 1 (Altinity adapter) has landed, so shared hosted-ClickHouse patterns are visible before cloning. If the Altinity adapter reveals abstraction-worthy duplication, propose the shared base in that PR rather than here.

Guardrails: same as Altinity adapter (manifest authority, lazy imports, compat-docs-check, no credentials, 7-10 files).
